work_experience.description: Upgraded enterprise-level applications from React 16 to React 18 across multiple modules, improving performance, scalability, and maintainability. projects.name: LevoHub - Construction workflow management
projects.description: System to manage construction workflows, including project tracking, time management, and team coordination. Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) to handle user roles and permissions for structured operations. Developed live workflow tracking and real-time notification features to improve task visibility and team communication. Built project management and employee time tracking modules to monitor progress and resource utilization. Developed a Progressive Web Application (PWA) to enable mobile access for employees.

projects.name: Kathawo - Real-Time Social Dating Platform
projects.description: Built a real-time social dating platform enabling live user interactions and matchmaking. Implemented real-time 1:1 and group chat using Socket.io for low-latency messaging. Developed notification system for messages, matches, and user activity updates. Designed and implemented user verification workflow for trust and identity validation. Built scalable backend supporting real-time communication, status updates, and chat systems.

projects.name: Halloween Event Organizing Web Platform
projects.description: Developed a web platform to streamline event management and improve client communication for an Upwork client. Enabled users to view event schedules and book tickets through a responsive interface. Improved customer interaction flow by simplifying event browsing and booking experience. Built a responsive UI using React and Tailwind CSS for modern and scalable design.

projects.name: MindMap - 3D Mind Mapping and Knowledge Visualization Platform
projects.description: Developed an interactive 3D mind mapping platform with dynamic node creation, relationship management, and real-time visualization. Implemented node tagging, drag-and-drop positioning, zooming, and rotational navigation for enhanced user interaction. Integrated LLM-based features for intelligent idea generation and contextual relationship suggestions. Designed scalable frontend architecture and optimized graph rendering for smooth visualization performance.

projects.name: Studio Management System
projects.description: Developed a manager dashboard with POS, inventory management, event handling, and employee oversight. Created a mobile application to provide staff with on-the-go access to essential operational features. Built a customer-facing portal enabling seamless booking and service scheduling.

projects.name: Test Case Management System - Zephyr Replacement Solution
projects.description: Developed a scalable, low-cost test case management system as a replacement for the Jira-integrated Zephyr plugin. Implemented Excel-based bulk import/export and advanced search functionalities for efficient test case management. Integrated Active Directory (AD) authentication with multi-project support to improve accessibility and scalability. Designed interactive UIs and flexible test execution workflows to enhance QA operations and user engagement.

projects.name: Green Heven - Plantation E-commerce project
projects.description: Developed a full-featured e-commerce platform for a plant shop with separate customer and admin interfaces. Built a customer portal with product browsing, cart management, secure checkout, and real-time order tracking. Implemented an admin dashboard for product/category management, order monitoring, and performance insights. Integrated Stripe for secure payment processing and transactions. Designed a microservices-based architecture, with OAuth authentication and Redis-based session management.
